atoms.b: If a backshift of tenses is required, past tenses are always shifted into ((++past_perfect simple_past present_perfect)). Progressive forms of the past are always shifted into ((++past_perfect_progressive past_perfect present_progressive)).

instruction.text: Insert the correct form for indirect speech.

atoms.a: David acknowledges, “We discussed the ethical implications of artificial intelligence.”
atoms.b: David acknowledges that they ((had_discussed ++discussed have_discussed)) the ethical implications of artificial intelligence.
